reason_codes.description: Assessee has income under 'Income from Other Sources' as per AIS/Form 26AS that has not been offered to tax in the return of income filed.

detailed_reason: As per Annual Information Statement (AIS), dividend income of Rs 1,040 (SFT-015, reported by Zerodha Broking Ltd/RTA) and savings bank interest of Rs 2,300 (SFT-016, reported by Demo Bank) have been identified for PAN ZZAPD1234E for AY 2026-27. These amounts do not appear to have been included under the head 'Income from Other Sources' in the return filed on 22-Jul-2026.
action_required: File a corrected return in response to this notice within the response due date, u/s 139(9), including the omitted income. Use the 'e-Proceedings' tab on the e-filing portal, select this DIN, and upload the revised computation.
consequence_of_non_response: If no response is filed by the due date, the return filed on 22-Jul-2026 shall be treated as an invalid return u/s 139(9), as if no return had been filed for AY 2026-27.
